_comment: Opening-masterclass content manifests (David 2026-05-22). Each first-class opening declares its MINIMUM curated content counts; the openingManifests test gates against them. These are REGRESSION FLOORS, never targets. David's directive (2026-05-22): NO hard rules on the NUMBER of key ideas / traps / variations. A floor is simply 'what was verified as ground truth at last commit' — set it to the count you could verify (it may be 2, or 9), never pad to hit a number, and there is no upper cap (more verifiable content is always welcome — the gate only checks actual >= floor). The floor exists ONLY to catch accidental REGRESSIONS (a deleted variation, a dropped plan, a lost weapon); it must never be read as 'this opening should have N of X'. Floors ratchet UP as verified content lands; down only via explicit demotion here.

_schema.middlegamePlans: min plans in middlegame-plans.json with openingId match, id NOT ending -endgame
_schema.endgamePlans: min plans in middlegame-plans.json with openingId match, id ending -endgame
_schema.modelGames: min entries in model-games.json with openingId match
_schema.weapons: min `kind: 'weapon'` entries in <opening>TrapLessons.ts (0 if no trap file)
